name: tehcha-bms
description: 得茶 Tehcha · 手搖飲管理系統 (BMS): Vue 3 front end + TypeScript API on Vercel + PostgreSQL (Neon)

scripts.vercel-build: node backend/scripts/migrate.mjs --seed-if-empty --skip-without-db && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
